Guys, I have a question.

What if you had something similar to Grok, but instead of running everything in the cloud, you had your own local virtual machine running directly on your phone?

You could connect any CLI or AI model you want, using your existing subscriptions. The platform would charge you only for tool connections, integrations, and other essential services—around $5–$10 per month.

Here’s the real difference:

Your device, your data: Your data stays on your phone instead of being stored in the cloud.

Your own local VM: The virtual machine runs directly on your phone, with your agents and their execution environment operating locally.

Bring your own models: Connect whichever AI models you want through your existing subscriptions and CLI tools.

No expensive AI subscriptions: You pay for your own model subscriptions separately, while the platform charges only for integrations and tool connectivity.

Privacy-first architecture: Your conversations, files, and personal data remain on your device rather than being stored on the platform’s servers.

Essentially, imagine a Grok-like AI assistant with its own local virtual machine, running entirely on your phone, where you control the models, the agents, and your data.
